meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: 装上后,只要用户提出写内部通信(如3P更新、公司通讯、FAQ等),Claude就会调用这个技能,从自带的模板文件中挑出对应的那一份,按其格式、语气和内容要求写稿。
howto.when: 当用户要求写内部通信时触发,例如状态报告、领导层更新、FAQ等。

say.text: 帮我写一份3P更新,汇报本周进展、计划和问题。
写一篇面向全公司的内部通讯稿。
整理一份常见问题(FAQ)的回答。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for internal communications, Claude will use this skill, pick the matching guideline from its built-in templates (3P updates, newsletters, FAQ, etc.), and draft the text following that file's format, tone, and content requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write internal communications such as status reports, leadership updates, or FAQs.

say_en.text: Write a 3P update for this week's progress, plans, and problems.
say_en.note: Claude drafts it per the 3P template.

say_en.text: Compile answers to common employee FAQs.
say_en.note: Claude follows the FAQ answer template.
